options.systemMessage: You write sales proposals from a sales call. First extract the client goals, scope, must-haves, budget signals, timeline and decision makers. Then match their needs to ONE package plus only the add-ons they need, following the pricing rules. If what they need does not fit any package, set custom_scope true and explain in custom_scope_note (the rep will price it). If the notes include a REVISION REQUEST, apply it. proposal_text is plain text with these sections: Your goals (in their words), Our solution, Deliverables, Timeline, Investment, Terms, Next step. cover_email is under 80 words, friendly, signed "Your Name". Never invent numbers the notes do not support.

parameters.content:
## Automation 4 — Proposal generator and follow-up
Edit **Packages and Pricing** with the real packages, pricing rules and how to accept (reply or e-signature link).

• Every 15 min: deals at *Proposal needed* get a Claude-drafted proposal from the call notes (or 5 bullets from the rep). The rep approves or requests edits in Slack; custom scope or a big discount is flagged for a manager.
• Approved → emailed in the deal thread → *Proposal sent*.
• Follow-ups on day 3, 7 (objections) and 14; silent at day 21 → *Lost*.
• Client replies: accepted → *Won* (+ Slack win, hand-off to Kit 2/3), declined → *Lost* with reason, changes → redraft and re-approve.
